name: Just-In-Time Activation Ready for Requested-For Identity
description: Notifies a manager, owner, or other interested party that a Just-In-Time activation window initiated by another identity is now active.
subject: Just-In-Time access for ${requestedForIdentityName} is ready
body:
Just-In-Time Activation Ready

Dear $__recipient.name,

A Just-In-Time activation window is now active. Review the details below.

Initiated by: ${requestedForIdentityName}

Requested for: ${entitlementName}

Now activated for: ${activationDuration}

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.

Thank you for using $__global.productName.
